Task: Copy the following passage exactly, without a preface or commentary:
The library opens at nine in the morning and closes at six in the evening. Visitors can borrow books for three weeks. To renew a loan, use the online catalog or speak to the librarian. Quiet study rooms are on the second floor. The ground floor has a help desk, newspapers, and a small collection of maps. Please return books through the blue return slot beside the main entrance.<|im_end|>

Please return books through the blue return slot beside the main entrance.
